title: Lesson 13 - Post-implementation adoption diagnostics: finding why users stopped
description: Post-implementation, determine how to respond to low adoption and changing business requirements, user access and plan for continuous improvement.

questions.question: Users were granted the new Agentforce app a month ago and have opened it twice. What is your first diagnostic step?
options: Verify the permission set assignment and app visibility using Login As
Add more fields to the record page
questions.explanation: Access precedes adoption, so confirming the permission set assignment and what the user actually sees with Login As separates a missing grant from a genuine usage problem.

questions.question: Which measurement best identifies friction inside the AI agent itself?
options: The number of logins to the org
The number of records created in the month
The share of sessions escalated to a human and the topics behind them
The average page load time of the console
questions.explanation: Agent Analytics reports sessions, resolutions, and escalations, and the escalation topics point directly at the prompt, action, or data that needs work.

questions.question: What does the Setup Audit Trail give you during a post-implementation review?
options: A log of setup changes covering about the last 180 days
A live stream of every user click in the org
Full transcripts of every agent session
Event-level telemetry for all users without an add-on license
questions.explanation: The Setup Audit Trail records setup changes for roughly 180 days, which is why a review that spans longer than that must export the trail before the window rolls.
